summary: Iteration 9 testing complete. Backend pytest 10/10 PASS — AI Semantic Router (gpt-5.2) end-to-end verified: (1) 'dynamic qr' → semantic suggestions list contains QR/UPI KB items (source=ai_router_suggestion); (2) 'how to bake a chocolate cake' with scope_fallback_message='I only know about {modules}...' and enabled_module_labels=['Sales Invoices','GST'] → SSE fallback with {modules} replaced by 'Sales Invoices, GST', stored as source=scope_fallback; (3) verbatim 'How to Configure Amount-Based QR Code ?' → direct-serve (source ∈ {ai_router_direct, kb_direct}, conf ≥ 90, no suggestions, full markdown token); (4) PUT /api/admin/ai-config {use_ai_router:false} disables router (OOS query no longer hits scope_fallback path); (5) smart-gap pending_resolution rows NOT visible in /api/admin/unanswered; (6) clicking verbatim suggestion deletes pending_resolution; (7) OOS still creates visible source='fallback' pending row; (8) /api/admin/users excludes role∈{user,end_user} (verified only super_admin+support_manager returned, total=2); (9) POST /api/auth/google/session: 400 on missing session_id, 401/500 on invalid. Frontend verified: AI Config card shows all 4 testids (ai-router-toggle, default-fallback-input, scope-fallback-input, enabled-modules-input); AuthCallback renders for /#session_id=<id>, redirects to /login on failure; Admin Users page shows only Super Admin + Support Manager (no end-users). NOTABLE BUG: Google login button is rendered ONLY on the Create Account (Register) tab in LoginPage.js — missing on the Sign In tab. Review request explicitly states 'Google G logo on both Sign In and Create Account tabs'.

ui_bugs.issue:
Google 'Continue with Google' button (data-testid='google-login-button') is rendered ONLY inside via . The contains the email/password form but NO GoogleButton component. Per review spec, both tabs must show the Google button. Fix: insert immediately after the 'Welcome back' header div inside the login TabsContent (LoginPage.js, around line 139 — between of header and
).

integration_issues.issue: Visiting /#session_id=fake correctly renders <auth-callback> and on POST /api/auth/google/session failure calls navigate('/login?error=google-failed'). However in the test the final URL was https://.../login (no '?error=google-failed' query string). This is likely because the React Router replace happened but the query persisted only in the history state. Functionally not blocking — fallback page still loads — but the LoginPage cannot show a 'Google sign-in failed' notice. Suggest adding a useSearchParams hook in LoginPage to surface error=google-failed as a toast/banner.

action_items: Add <GoogleButton /> to the Sign In TabsContent in /app/frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.js (currently only on Create Account tab). Reuse the existing GoogleButton component defined at lines 57–75; insert above <form onSubmit={handleLogin}> at around line 140.
(Optional) Surface ?error=google-failed in LoginPage as a visible toast/error so users know why they bounced back.
critical_code_review_comments: chat_routes.py is now 1200 lines (>700 threshold). Already flagged in iter8 — strongly recommend extracting ai_semantic_route, find_exact_kb_match, normalize_for_match, track_unanswered, search_*, and the 4 router branches into ai_router.py / chat_matching.py modules. The router branches (PRIORITY 0a-i … 0a-iv) at lines 733–882 alone are ~150 LOC of duplicated 'build answer / translate / insert msg / make_sse' logic — extract to a helper.
LoginPage.js: GoogleButton is defined inside the LoginPage component on every render — extract to module scope or wrap in useMemo to avoid re-creating the function/JSX tree on each keystroke.

auth_routes.py google_session endpoint: hardcodes the Emergent OAuth URL inside the function. While the comment says 'don't hardcode' (referring to redirect URLs), this is the correct fixed external endpoint — OK. But returning the raw Emergent error body in HTTPException(401, f'Google auth failed: {r.text[:200]}') may leak provider internals to clients; consider a generic 'Google authentication failed' message.
admin_routes.list_users uses {'role': {'$nin': ['user','end_user']}} — correctly hides end users. Good. Suggest indexing db.users on 'role' if user table grows.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 pytest pass — router semantic, router OOS+module substitution, router direct-serve, toggle off, gap hidden, gap cleanup, gap OOS visible, users filter, google session 400, google session invalid)

rca of the issue: Bug: 'Continue with Google' button missing from Sign In tab of /login. RCA: LoginPage.js lines 135–168 (<TabsContent value='login'>) contain the email/password form but never invoke <GoogleButton />. The component <GoogleButton /> is only rendered inside <TabsContent value='register'> at line 175. Reproduce: open /login (default tab is Sign In) → no Google button visible. Switch to Create Account tab → Google button appears. Mitigation: insert <GoogleButton /> right before the <form onSubmit={handleLogin}> (i.e. between line 139 and 140) — mirrors the placement in the register tab.
